name: mcal_respond_invite
description: Accept or decline an event invite the user received, by `event_id` (get it from mcal_list_invites). Set `rsvp` to 'accepted' or 'declined'. ACCEPTING copies the event onto the user's own calendar (a dedicated 'Invitations' calendar, auto-created the first time) so it shows up in mcal_list_calendars / mcal_list_events; DECLINING removes that copy. Idempotent — re-accepting won't duplicate it. The organizer sees the updated RSVP. Only affects the caller's own invite; returns no content on success (404 if there is no invite for this user on that event).

rsvp.description: 'accepted' (copies the event onto the user's calendar) or 'declined' (removes any copy).
